assets.caption: The scene is a surreal and highly stylized cylindrical tunnel, rendered with vibrant, glossy colors that evoke a dreamlike, almost futuristic atmosphere. The overall tone is energetic and whimsical, characterized by intense luminosity and fluid motion. The tunnel is a perfectly straight, cylindrical washing-machine drum, extending directly from the viewer towards a single, bright, warm-golden vanishing point. Its walls are composed of deep, glossy metallic magenta and violet surfaces, streaked with long white-pink specular highlights that run longitudinally along the tunnel's length. Regularly spaced rows of dark, capsule-shaped perforation slots are arranged around the circumference of the walls, positioned between a series of ten evenly spaced, identical, circular, polished, reflective yellow-gold ring bands. These flat bands, each featuring a subtle double lip, divide the tunnel into equal bays that diminish in size consistently towards the vanishing point. Within each bay, a small copper-gold half-dome fitting is mounted on each side wall, positioned just above the water level. The entire floor of this tunnel is filled from wall to wall with a broad, thick, glossy electric-cyan river, which is interspersed with swirling bands of hot-pink. This luminous river meanders in smooth S-bends as it flows towards the vanishing point, its surface alive with white-blue reflections and numerous star-shaped glints. Both sides of the river are lined with soft banks of white foam, from which transparent, iridescent soap bubbles gently rise and float. The 360 scene is faultless.
